| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Phases | Phases, Boundaries over the image, Mean color of each phase, Level set | The two phases as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or the boundary in yellow over the image, or each phase filled with its mean color. Or the final level set as gray, with 0 at middle gray. |
| **Length weight** `mu` | 0.25 | 0 to 2 | The weight mu of the length of the boundary. scikit-image uses 0.25. |
| **Phase 1 weight** `lambda1` | 1 | 0 to 5 | How much an uneven phase 1 costs, lambda 1. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Phase 2 weight** `lambda2` | 1 | 0 to 5 | How much an uneven phase 2 costs, lambda 2. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Start** `init` | Checkerboard | Checkerboard, Large disk, Small disk | The starting level set from scikit-image. The checkerboard has squares of 5 pixels. The large disk spans the shorter side of the image, the small disk half of it. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 500 | 1 to 2000 | The most steps to take. scikit-image uses 500. |
| **Tolerance** `tolerance` | 0.001 | 0 to 0.1 | The level set stops when its root mean square change in one step is at most this. scikit-image uses 0.001. |
| **Time step** `dt` | 0.5 | 0.01 to 2 | The size of each step, delta t. scikit-image uses 0.5. |
